surface: OpenClaw CLI and its local Gateway runtime.
launch: The launch scripts use the CLI entry at /app/src/entry.ts with the image's tsx loader. The Gateway starts on loopback with an empty temporary state directory and requires both readiness and liveness before use.
cleanup: Helpers remove their temporary state. Gateway shuts down only the child it launched and checks that its loopback endpoint is closed.

excluded.install: Needs a separate writable fixture and install provenance assertions.
excluded.update: A version-changing ClawHub fixture must be set up before testing updates.
excluded.verify: Requires a controlled ClawHub response and package provenance fixture.
excluded.workshop: Archive and restore need a disposable learned-skill state history.
excluded.library: Needs an authenticated test account and an isolated library or service fixture.
excluded.search: Needs a controlled search backend and test catalogue.

doctor.drive: Run openclaw --version in an isolated home.
doctor.observe: Require the CLI version to match package.json in the attested image.
doctor.gotchas: Version checks verify CLI startup. Gateway readiness is checked again after the journey starts its own instance.

features.reach: Start OpenClaw Gateway on loopback and ask the CLI for Gateway health.
features.drive: Start a disposable Gateway, require both /readyz and /healthz and run openclaw gateway health --json.
features.observe: The real CLI receives a successful health RPC from the instance it started. Cleanup stops the child and closes the port.
features.gotchas: The helper disables bundled plugins and uses a synthetic local token. No existing OpenClaw instance is used.

features.reach: Ask the CLI which skills are available to the main agent.
features.drive: Run openclaw skills check --json in a temporary workspace, first without the configured prerequisite and then with it.
features.observe: The ready skill is discovered. The conditional skill moves from missing its prerequisite to eligible. The fixture inputs are unchanged.
features.gotchas: Bundled skills are disabled so the assertion exercises local discovery in the temporary workspace.

features.reach: List available skills and inspect one named skill from a local OpenClaw terminal.
features.drive: Run openclaw skills list and openclaw skills info with JSON and the main agent in a disposable workspace.
features.observe: The list includes the eligible workspace skill. Info shows the exact metadata and SKILL.md path. An absent name exits one with a structured not-found error. Inputs are unchanged.
features.gotchas: Bundled skills are disabled and all reads use the temporary config and workspace.

features.reach: Ask the CLI to validate the current OpenClaw configuration.
features.drive: Run openclaw config validate --json once with a valid fixture and once with a string in gateway.port.
features.observe: The first invocation exits zero. The second exits one and identifies gateway.port. Both fixture files are unchanged.
features.gotchas: Use the isolated state directory. The validation command does not launch a Gateway.
